export_scannet_scene: export a Scannet scene to numpy arrays with vertices, semantic labels, instance labels, and bounding boxes
read_scannet_aggregation: read a Scannet aggregation JSON file and return object-to-segments and label-to-segments mappings
read_scannet_segmentation: read a Scannet segmentation JSON file and return segment-to-vertices mapping and vertex count
run_scannet_export_cli: run the Scannet scene export CLI with scan path, output file, and label map file arguments
align_scannet_mesh_vertices: align Scannet mesh vertices using the scene axis alignment matrix from the meta file
